weather.help: Atmospheric lighting, caustics, and color palette (Sunny, Sunset, Moonlight, Rain, Overcast, Mist, Deep Clear).

rain.help: Enable dynamic rain droplets and fluid ripple rings across the surface.

sound.help: Gentle procedural river stream water audio loop.

clock_enabled.help: Toggle the frosted glass pond clock.

clock_mode.help: Submerged: Sunken beneath swimming fish with water caustics. Floating: Surface HUD.

clock_format.help: Display in standard 24-hour time or 12-hour AM/PM format.

clock_seconds.help: Show animated seconds counter badge beside the main digits.

clock_opacity.help: Overall transparency of the frosted glass clock.

clock_position.help: Clock is anchored at Center of Pond (or set Clock Style to Off) ensuring the boat orbits gracefully around it.

boat_scale.help: Adjust the scale of the traditional wooden pixel boat (0% disables the boat).

boat_speed.help: Adjust the orbit cruising speed of the wooden boat around the clock (0% pauses movement).

boat_position.help: Anchor location for the wooden boat across the pond.

koicount.help: Total population of procedural koi fish swimming in the pond (1 to 48).

scatter.help: Trigger a tactile panic impulse causing all koi to dart away.

reset.help: Reset koi population and reseed color genetics.

framerate.help: Target frame rate limit. Lower values conserve GPU power and battery on laptops.

visitorfrequency.help: Interval between visits from rare legendary nomadic fish.

mutationchance.help: Probability for eligible koi to evolve into mythical mutant variants.

cycle_interval.help: Time interval before fish cycle and re-roll metamorphic evolutions.

allow_abyssal.help: Deep oceanic trench koi with vibrant blue-purple bioluminescence and glowing particles.

allow_astraeus.help: Deep celestial cosmic indigo fish surrounded by starry halos.

allow_serene.help: Bioluminescent emerald-jade koi with calming wake ripples.

allow_umbra.help: Void silhouette crowned by a 360-degree rotating solar eclipse corona.

allow_aurora.help: Borealis gradient hues shifting across scales.

allow_frozen.help: Encased within a floating crystalline ice block that obstacles other fish.

allow_electric.help: Crackling electric aura pulsing along spinal fins.

allow_ishmael.help: High-contrast albino white and obsidian ink.
